title: Update 26.2 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2024 Release Wave 1
summary: Update 26.2 for Business Central 2025 release wave 1 includes hotfixes, feature changes across Copilot, e-documents, financial management, reporting, and sustainability, plus localization updates for Mexico and upcoming mandatory features.
features: Send e-documents via service and email simultaneously
B2B Router as e-document service provider
Analyze subscription billing with Power BI
Add fields from related tables in analysis mode
Enhanced analytics for manufacturing, projects, purchasing, sales, and sustainability
